description: 臺中市橋樑基本資訊 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府建設局. 臺中市橋樑基本資訊資料集提供了關於市內橋樑的基本資訊，內容包括橋樑名稱、位置、類型、座標、長度、寬度、座標等基本資訊。 這些資訊有助於民眾了解市內橋樑的分布和特徵，同時也為城市規劃、交通管理等相關工作提供了重要的參考資料。. Coverage: 臺中市政府建設局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府建設局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
